description: Agent Governance: submit an agent budget setup: its maximum per payment, session or daily budget with its period, permitted recipients, revocation path with when it takes effect and who can use it, and spending record with when a payment appears and who can read it. The signed report gives each of five controls (maximum per payment, period budget, permitted recipients, immediate revocation and live spending record) present, weak or missing, and names budgets that cap totals and leave recipients open, revocation that is not immediate and spending records nobody can read while money is moving. Enforcing a budget on one request is wever_agent-budget-guard and an approval against a standing limit is wever_approval-policy-check. Verdict controls_missing, controls_weak, coverage_unverified or full_coverage. POST /api/budget-controls-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-governance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-governance/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

period_budget.description: Session or daily budget, or none.

readable_by.description: Who can read it while payments run.

updated.description: When a payment appears in the record.
